scripts.install-all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
